author: Claf
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?
18

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)
clef#3819

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
i <3 minecraft

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
i play minecraft all the the time and i really like to build in minecraft it is one of my favorite things to do when playing minecraft i really hope u consider me because im a good minecraft builder and also roblox i like build ing roblox. i like making minecraft tournament maps and am on the badlion BULDING tEAM

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
triplezko is a necessity in order to hone my map building skillls in terms of gameplay because he is good at minecraft xml and he makes xml and code for my minecraft map so he should be builder too

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
i did ocn xml b4 so i know ocn xml but avicus xml is poop when it comes to documentation so is much harder to understand especially for triplezko but WE WILL GET BETER

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
i like build minecraft competivie maps

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
https://avicus.net/forums/68596c927 i made tourney map for finals of ur tourney hahahahhaha
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/6442943b4?page=1 this is not submit but i remake fouled's map draxel for the tournament also remade xuph's map heat so it better looks

Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
I, Claf, fellow minecraft engineer, would like to formally state that I have never made another map in my life other than the maps listed above, so help me Notch my almighty god.

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
To rub it in ItzaMeLuigi's face that i got builder on here because he told me I'm not qualifiied for stratus mapdev :( also because triplezko told me to. also also p.s. p.s. i like minecraft building and competitive miencraft because minecraft is very fun for me to play also roblox is pretty fun for build also i want a better understanding on the making of competitive maps for minecraft to make play well haha

How do you think you will help the map development team?
i make ur tournaments not as suck maybe

replies.body:
Hello Claf,

Your application is considered to be a joke one, and thus cannot be accepted. This application is denied, but you may submit a new one before the deadline, if you wish to take this seriously. If you post another joke application, you will not be allowed to submit any more applications during the next two builder application periods.

Thank you.
